subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this security-sensitive batch of workflow-action upgrades merge only after maintainers verify the Codex-action contract and observe successful scoped runs of the token and agent workflow paths?
rationale: The patch changes external workflow executables in credential-bearing and agent-execution paths; the necessary acceptance boundary cannot be established from Dependabot release notes or unit-style checks alone.

options.title: Require scoped workflow proof
options.body: Verify the Codex action contract and obtain redacted successful runs for the affected token and Codex-agent paths before merging.

options.title: Accept upstream-action risk
options.body: Merge based on immutable upstream pins and existing CI, explicitly accepting that the sensitive paths were not separately exercised.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Hold or replace the combined Dependabot update if maintainers prefer smaller, individually verified action upgrades.

recommendation.title: Require scoped workflow proof
recommendation.body: Verify the Codex action contract and obtain redacted successful runs for the affected token and Codex-agent paths before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: A CI/workflow owner is needed to evaluate credentials, dispatch permissions, and the Codex-agent workflow contract.
